verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents its own programmatic eval execution through Python and TypeScript SDKs. Its dataset evaluators form a unit-test-like harness for spotting regressions, which is the core needed to run evals from a pipeline. Nothing in the evidence describes CI integration or deployment gating on eval results. Missing for 10: documented CI integration (e.g. GitHub Actions recipe), pass/fail thresholds or exit codes for gating deployments, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run evals in CI and gate deployments on their results

citations.quote: Python and TypeScript SDKs for running evaluations against Phoenix traces, datasets, or any data source. Full control over evaluation logic, judge models, and pipelines.
Dataset Evaluators serve as **test cases** that automatically score outputs when running experiments—forming an evaluation harness similar to a unit test suite.
score outputs using evaluation tests to identify failures and regressions
